ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point $O$, with $OE$ bisecting $\angle AOD$ and $\angle FOC = 90^\circ$, $\angle 1 = 40^\circ$. Find the measure of $\angle 2$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $ \because \angle FOC=90^\circ$ and $ \angle 1=40^\circ$,\\
$ \therefore \angle AOC=180^\circ-\angle FOC-\angle 1=180^\circ-90^\circ-40^\circ=50^\circ$,\\
$ \therefore \angle AOD=180^\circ-\angle AOC=180^\circ-50^\circ=130^\circ$,\\
$ \because OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$,\\
$ \therefore \angle 2=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOD=\frac{1}{2}\times 130^\circ=\boxed{65^\circ}$.
